description: This is a Python source file defining a TorchScript-compatible functional Adamax optimizer class, used within the PyTorch distributed training framework. It includes class initialization, validation, and a step method to update parameters with provided gradients.

classes.name: _FunctionalAdamax
classes.description: A TorchScript-compatible implementation of the Adamax optimizer designed for distributed use, allowing explicit passing of gradients and separation of parameter updates in a multi-threaded environment.

methods.description: Initializes the _FunctionalAdamax optimizer with parameters, learning rate, betas, epsilon, weight decay, and other flags. Also validates inputs and sets up optimizer state.

methods.description: Performs a single optimization step given a list of gradients, updating internal state and applying the Adamax update rule via TorchScript.
